# PART 4 – Multiverse, replication and preregistration {#part-4-multiverse-replication-and-preregistration .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 4 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Last part. You spent the end of Part 3 trying specifications and reading how the estimate moved. Now we give that activity its proper name and read it as a chart: every justifiable analysis of this claim on the rebuilt data, with the published result placed on it. Then the two replications of this paper, which turn out to have tested two different numbers, and what that means for the verdict that SCORE recorded. Then the question that every repetition of this paper raises, about what made the error of Part 3 findable at all. And then you settle on one analysis, preregister it before you run it, and submit it to the class chart.
:::
